what: Scenes of the Demo Day deck (artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/Un6kuB2TQxna7rDpiqruFQ; owner, 22 Nov 2026: «проект сильный… нормально оформить все»). New scene types, used nowhere else: an intermodal crane on a harbour quay, a railway lever frame at a junction, a lighthouse on a coastal headland. Zholdas looks at the viewer only on the cover and the last slide; in the middle he works the lever and looks at the points. Each world runs out through the right and bottom edges; the calm left side holds the text.
processing: 2688x1520 PNG resized to 1920x1080 WebP q84. The junction scene was outpainted to 21:9 (job 723dd22c-8531-40b5-85a1-a74a3a0f640b) and its left 16:9 window kept, so Zholdas stands right of centre and the text has room.

cover-port.webp.scene: a brick-red gantry crane lifts a sage container from a freight train onto a truck on a harbour quay, a ferry at sea; Zholdas with a clipboard says hello to the viewer

what-switch.webp.scene: a railway junction in a felt valley, a signal box, a road bridge with a truck, a container train coming; Zholdas pulls a brass lever and watches the points move

close-lighthouse.webp.scene: a striped lighthouse on a headland, a coastal road with a truck, a freight train along the shore, a ferry sailing out; Zholdas waves to the viewer with a rolled map
